Title: Kunal's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Sonali - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Rajesh - 41 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Aarav - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sonali and Aarav stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Aarav (happily): "One more time!"

[Kunal munches on an apple.]

Kunal: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Aarav stand near him.]

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Kunal bursts out laughing.]

Aarav (gently): "Kunal, listen!"

[Kunal starts crying.]

Sonali (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Kunal smiles at Mother.]

Aarav (excited): "And then?"

[Kunal stamps his foot in anger.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal gets frightened and steps back.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
